reference.source: Ananthanarayan and Paniker's Textbook of Microbiology (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Rheumatic needs years of prophylaxis; glomerulonephritis needs support
Conjugate primes memory, polysaccharide covers breadth
reference.pathophysiology: M protein fibrils repel phagocytes while superantigen exotoxins fire T cells; nephritogenic strains deposit immune complexes clogging glomeruli as complement falls, and pneumococcal capsule slips past splenic clearance until opsonised.
additionalDifferentials: Rheumatic fever versus glomerulonephritis by joints, heart and C3
Erysipelas versus cellulitis by raised edge
Pyogenes versus agalactiae by bacitracin and CAMP
additionalInvestigations: Throat culture with ASO and anti-DNase B titres
Blood and CSF culture with optochin, bile and quellung
Antenatal GBS screen with intrapartum prophylaxis protocol
